item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J01075","case1_error":"Leading answer marker says 600, but the derivation and concluding answer correctly give 400 legs.","case2_error":"Counts two empty tires as containing 1,000 cubic inches of air, understating the air needed.","reason":"Case 1 has only an answer-marker conflict; case 2 incorrectly treats empty tires as full.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J01076","case1_error":"Multiplies miles directly by dollars per gallon, omitting division by miles per gallon when calculating fuel cost.","case2_error":"Evaluates the correctly written distance sum 8 + 6 + 12 + 24 as 40 instead of 50.","reason":"Case 1 uses an incorrect cost relation; case 2 makes a numerical evaluation error in a correct expression.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01077","case1_error":"Reports the seven brownies given to Carl and Simon as the number remaining, instead of subtracting them from ten.","case2_error":"Divides average weights by group sizes to obtain totals, despite stating that totals require multiplication.","reason":"Case 1 answers with the quantity given away; case 2 uses an erroneous relation between averages and totals.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01078","case1_error":"Evaluates 48 − 17 − 10 as 11 instead of 21, propagating the error into profit.","case2_error":"Subtracts restaurant apples twice, miscalculates that expression, introduces 56 bags without support, and incorrectly evaluates 408 ÷ 56.","reason":"Case 1 has a numerical evaluation error alone. Case 2 additionally double-counts a deduction and uses an unsupported bag count.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01079","case1_error":"Applies only two halvings over thirty years, assigning the first halving to age twenty rather than ten.","case2_error":"Divides the entire weekly requirement by five elapsed days, ignoring consumed vegetables and the two remaining days.","reason":"Case 1 omits a required repeated halving; case 2 forms the wrong rate from total requirements and elapsed time.","judgment":"different"}]}
